decisive_items: diffuse bilateral cortical and subcortical edema
response.rationale: Seizures temporally linked to synthetic cannabis use with positive urine screen and diffuse cerebral edema favor toxic-induced seizure disorder; PRES is less specific without hypertension or posterior predominance.

rejected.why: No hyperemesis or gastrointestinal symptoms; history of cannabis use alone insufficient.
Imaging shows diffuse bilateral edema, not typical posterior-predominant PRES; no hypertension or other PRES triggers.
